name: Exaiphanes Blade
description: A longsword that once shone with the light of the very stars. In the voyager's hand, it becomes a brand-new light that has nothing to do with any past era.
passive_desc: When the Traveler equips this, their ATK will increase by 16% for 8s after they hit an opponent. At the same time, they will also regenerate 3 Elemental Energy. This effect can trigger once every 5s. This can be triggered even when the character is not on the field.
